title: Withdrawals
subtitle: Send funds to one of your confirmed addresses. You see every fee before you confirm.
noWalletText: Withdrawals go only to addresses you have added and confirmed by email.
coolingDownText: This address was added recently and can be used from {{date}}.
mfaNeededText: Turn it on in Security before you request a withdrawal.
feeExplained: The platform fee and network fee are deducted from the amount. The network fee pays the blockchain to process the transfer.
processingNote: Staff review every withdrawal before it is sent. You will get a notification and an email at each step.
quoteExpiredText: The quote expired. Get a new one to see current fees.
createdText: Reference {{reference}}. {{amount}} will be sent after review. The amount is reserved in your balance until then.

fee.title: 3% platform fee
fee.text: Deducted from the amount you withdraw and shown before you confirm.

network.title: Network fee
network.text: Set per network and shown in your quote.

hold.title: 7-day hold on new deposits
hold.text: Deposited funds become withdrawable {{count}} days after they are credited.

cooldown.title: New addresses wait
cooldown.text: An address can be used a short time after you confirm it, which protects you if your email is compromised.

review.title: Reviewed by staff
review.text: Large amounts need two approvers. You are notified when the funds are sent.

cancel.title: Change your mind
cancel.text: You can cancel a request while it is pending; the reserved amount returns to your balance.

emptyText: Your withdrawal requests and their status appear here.
cancelText: Request {{reference}} will be cancelled and the reserved amount returns to your available balance.
cancelled: Withdrawal cancelled. The amount is back in your available balance.
dualApprovalNote: Because of its size, this withdrawal needs approval from two staff members.
